page.overview:
What is Doyle house?

The Doyle residence is the household of the Doyle family, consisting of: Tommy Doyle and his parents. The house was located directly across the street from the Wallace house.

On Halloween night, 1978, Laurie Strode was babysitting Tommy Doyle here when they were attacked by the Shape. It was here that Samuel Loomis saved Laurie, Tommy and Lindsey Wallace by shooting the Shape six times with his pistol. Unfortunately for all, the Shape survived.

Afterwards, the Doyles decided to move away to another area of Haddonfield.
